dataset.name: Liefkenshoektunnel toll (Antwerp)
dataset.method: NV Tunnel Liefkenshoek's tariffs 2027: category 2 (vehicles 3 m high or more; trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be) per passage either way, VAT included: EUR 25.00 cash (standaardtarief) 06:01-21:59 and 8.00 22:00-06:00; `etc` the Teletolbadge & OBU price, 17.95 and 4.49 (bank, fuel or credit card: 22.34 and 6.32, not modelled). Without a departure time, the day price.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: NV Tunnel Liefkenshoek: Tarieven & abonnement, and Veelgestelde vragen (categories) (read in Chrome: tools/tables/browser/be-liefkenshoek.txt)

vehicles.description: Category 2: vehicles 3 m high or more (here: trucks over 3.5 t)

network.description: The Liefkenshoektunnel (R2, Antwerp), charged at its toll plaza either way.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
